uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:pickle.text: This is Pickle. She's a cricket...

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:hook.text: and she's about to do something no cricket should ever do.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:pixie1.text: This is Pixie. She's a mayfly.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:pixie2.text: She grew up underwater, in a pond. Now, at the very end of her short life, she's landed on the shore.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:doodle1.text: And this is Doodle. A horsehair worm, no bigger than a speck...

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:eat.text: Pickle finds Pixie... and gobbles her up. Doodle included.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:grow1.text: Inside Pickle, Doodle grows. Quietly. Week after week.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:grow2.text: Until he's several times longer than she is, wound up tight inside her body.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:problem2.text: Doodle needs water to find a mate. And Pickle? Pickle lives on land.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:drawn.text: So something strange happens. Pickle starts wandering... restless... until she finds the water.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:how.text: Is Doodle steering her? Scientists think so... but how he does it is still a mystery.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:escape.text: In the water, Doodle slides out of Pickle, and swims off to find a mate.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:survive.text: And Pickle? If she can scramble back to dry land... she can actually survive.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:cycle1.text: Later, a new batch of worm eggs hatches in the pond.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:cycle2.text: The tiny larvae get swallowed by young insects, like Pixie once was.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:cycle3.text: They grow up, fly to land... and wait for the next hungry cricket.
